## Vocabulary

Terms this pack was harvested with, grouped by their relation to the concept; counts are units matched / sources. Zero-hit terms are listed under Coverage. On every unit line, `keywords:` names the terms that matched.

- **self**: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation (33/4)

## Structure and components

- [statement] ISG analyst Matt Aslett’s April 2023 assessment framed federation and SQL access as part of application-driven analytics and argued that MongoDB should clarify how its analytics capabilities complement separate BI, data-science, and machine-learning platforms. This is historical analyst positioning, not a performance benchmark. (low confidence) — https://research.isg-one.com/analyst-perspectives/mongodbs-atlas-delivers-data-driven-applications · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation

## How it works

- [statement] Billing distinguishes processed bytes from returned and transferred bytes, including transfers between query nodes and writes from $out or $merge. Partitioning only helps processing cost when a query avoids reading irrelevant data; a full scan can still read every partition. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/data-federation/ · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
- [statement] Partitioning does not reduce scans when a query still needs all data. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/adf-overview/query-performance-optimization.md

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Configure stores and virtual collection mappings through the Atlas UI visual or JSON editor, federation commands, or Atlas Administration API endpoints. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] The billing page lists processing at $5 per TB, rounds processed bytes up to the nearest megabyte, and applies a 10 MB processed-data minimum per query; transfer charges are additional. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/data-federation/ · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.manning.com/preview/mongodb-in-action-third-edition/chapter-16

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] MongoDB's cached limitations documentation lists 30 simultaneous queries per federated instance and a six-hour query time limit; maxTimeMS can impose a shorter timeout. Exceeding concurrency returns ResourceExhausted (402). (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/limitations.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
- [statement] The limitations page specifies 120 guaranteed simultaneous client connections per region, at most 30 concurrent queries per instance, and a six-hour query timeout shortened by maxTimeMS when applicable. Exceeding query concurrency returns ResourceExhausted (402); pipelines containing only $currentOp are exempt from that concurrency limit. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/limitations.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
- [statement] Data-processing limits can be set per query, day, week, or month at project and instance scope; the more restrictive matching limit applies. These controls do not cap retrieval or transfer charges. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/manage-query-limits.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
- [statement] Reaching a per-query processing limit stops that query; periodic limits normally block new queries while running queries finish. Optional termination can overshoot marginally and returns an error without results, while already processed bytes remain billable. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/manage-query-limits.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Processing limits can be configured per query, day, week or month at instance and project scope. They govern processing charges rather than retrieval or transfer charges; termination can overshoot marginally and already processed data remains billable. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/manage-query-limits.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Atlas Data Federation maps existing data stores into virtual databases and collections; it can query Atlas clusters, S3, Azure Blob Storage and HTTP sources without requiring a consolidated copy first. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/ · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.manning.com/preview/mongodb-in-action-third-edition/chapter-16
- [statement] Data Federation can export aggregation results through $out to Amazon S3 in formats including CSV, BSON and Parquet; Studio 3T documents this as a Data Federation-specific variant of $out. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/ · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://studio3t.com/download-resources/ebooks/3t_guide_to_aggregation.pdf
- [statement] Veezoo connects through the Atlas SQL Interface backed by a federated instance. Its setup uses the JDBC hostname and virtual database name; this Veezoo integration requires an Atlas cluster. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://docs.veezoo.com/veezoo/getting-started/database-connections/mongodb-atlas · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
- [statement] Veezoo warns that sampled SQL schemas can mishandle polymorphic fields and that nested documents and arrays need flattened views for import. Its guide recommends sqlSetSchema or regenerating stale schemas with sqlGenerateSchema. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://docs.veezoo.com/veezoo/getting-started/database-connections/mongodb-atlas · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
- [statement] Federation does not provide full MongoDB server parity: creating indexes on federated sources, change streams, and multi-document ACID transactions are unsupported. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/limitations.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
- [statement] A federated database instance can use object storage from only one cloud provider and one account within that provider; the instance itself runs in a specific cloud and region. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/limitations.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
- [statement] SERVER-104844 records a historical provisioning bug: CreateFederatedDatabase could return HTTP 200 for an overly long generated hostname, while subsequent DNS lookup and connection failed. The ticket was resolved on May 8, 2025; it does not establish a current defect. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-104844 · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
- [statement] Atlas Data Federation represents underlying stores as virtual databases and collections, enabling queries across Atlas clusters and external data without first consolidating everything into one physical collection. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.manning.com/preview/mongodb-in-action-third-edition/chapter-16
- [statement] Supported query sources documented here include Atlas clusters, Amazon S3, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage, and files at public HTTP/HTTPS URLs. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
- [statement] MongoDB-compatible clients can query a federated database instance. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/ · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/adf-overview/query-performance-optimization.md, https://docs.veezoo.com/veezoo/getting-started/database-connections/mongodb-atlas
- [statement] SQL clients can query a federated database instance through the Atlas SQL Interface. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/adf-overview/query-performance-optimization.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/, https://docs.veezoo.com/veezoo/getting-started/database-connections/mongodb-atlas
- [statement] MongoDB documents a JDBC Driver for querying federated data with SQL tools. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/ · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/adf-overview/query-performance-optimization.md, https://docs.veezoo.com/veezoo/getting-started/database-connections/mongodb-atlas
- [statement] The downstream-systems workflow exports Atlas collection data to object storage with $out, supports scheduled exports, and offers Parquet, CSV, BSON, and MongoDB Extended JSON formats. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/ · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.manning.com/preview/mongodb-in-action-third-edition/chapter-16
- [statement] A federated instance can use object storage from one cloud provider and one account within that provider. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/limitations.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md
- [statement] An Atlas cluster can be queried together with S3 or Azure object storage regardless of the cloud provider on which the Atlas cluster runs. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/limitations.md
- [statement] Federated results have no guaranteed document order without an explicit sort. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/limitations.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md
- [statement] Pagination with $skip over an unordered S3 query can skip different documents on repeated runs. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/supported-unsupported/limitations.md
- [statement] Federation prunes object-storage files using partition information. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/adf-overview/query-performance-optimization.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md
- [statement] Federation tries to push eligible stages, such as a locally executable $match, into an Atlas cluster. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/adf-overview/query-performance-optimization.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md
- [statement] Mapping a virtual collection to exactly one Atlas collection enables proxy forwarding without scanning data into the virtual collection; mappings spanning multiple Atlas collections do not receive this optimization. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/data-federation/query/query-federated-database.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
- [statement] Billing distinguishes processed bytes from returned/transferred bytes. The latter includes client results, inter-node transfers, and $out/$merge writes, so a small result set alone does not imply a small bill. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/data-federation/ · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://www.manning.com/preview/mongodb-in-action-third-edition/chapter-16
- [statement] Veezoo documents its own integration through an Atlas SQL federated instance: it requires an Atlas cluster, a database user, an allowed client IP, and the SQL/JDBC hostname. Its connector does not import nested documents or arrays as ordinary fields; the guide recommends flattening views and sqlGenerateSchema/sqlSetSchema for schema management. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://docs.veezoo.com/veezoo/getting-started/database-connections/mongodb-atlas · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
- [statement] In 2022 MongoDB renamed its existing Atlas Data Lake query service Atlas Data Federation while introducing a separately managed analytics-storage product under the Atlas Data Lake name. Historical references therefore require identifying which product a source means. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/announcing-atlas-data-federation-data-lake · keywords: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation · also: https://research.isg-one.com/analyst-perspectives/mongodbs-atlas-delivers-data-driven-applications
